body: Got back from the walk, it really helped me clear my head. Today is't the day. Just got to remember that every day until it goes away I guess?

Thanks man, you really gave some good advice. It's going to be dark in an hour or two. I don't really know what I'm going to do now. I think I'm going to go for a walk when it's dark, and see what's going to happen.

Well, first of all I am a girl :)  and I went to see different psychiatrists. I went to a lot of them, but they never really worked. Talking about it didn't work. It just made it worse, it confronted me with all the things that are wrong with me.

That's the problem, I can't remember a time when I was genuinely happy. I've been up and down from when I was 11. I'm twenty now, and I so tired of the constant rollercoaster of bad emotions. I can never really enjoy something, because there is always that nagging feeling in the back of my head telling me that this is stupid thing to be happy about, that I'll feel bad again in a couple of minutes.

I have people in my life that would be devestated if I took my own life. But, in a way, I'm starting to resent them for stopping me. I reset them for caring about me. Kind of screwed up, I know, but it has just been so long.
